Name: The Samaritan Woman
Summary: The Samaritan woman met Jesus at Jacob's well, received His offer of living water, and became the first evangelist to Samaria. Her testimony brought her whole town out to meet Jesus.
KeyStory: Leaving her water jar behind, she ran to the town saying, Come, see a man who told me everything I ever did — and many Samaritans believed.
LifeLesson: Jesus crossed every barrier to offer one thirsty woman living water, and she became a town's witness. He will meet you at your well today — and your story will bring others to Him.
